scope: Spanish authored corpus and fixed A/B inputs; no independent human annotation,judge-model experiment or representative-user claim
decoding: Preserve generated IDs and decode twice,with and without special tokens. Parser uses standard skip_special_tokens:true decode with no other rewriting. EOS IDs count as produced IDs. Never strip fences,extract a substring,repair JSON or retry a poor answer.

technicalContract.json: JSON.parse must consume the whole output; only outer JSON whitespace permitted; reject duplicate object keys including escaped equivalents
technicalContract.types: object,not array; status answered/no_answer; answer string; citations array of unique exact strings drawn from sources actually provided
technicalContract.answered: nonblank answer and at least one citation
technicalContract.no_answer: answer exactly empty string and citations exactly empty array
technicalContract.failure: retain raw output and stable failure reason; no semantic-score denominator or repaired answer

semanticReview.performer: Editorial review by the assistant preparing this lab,not an independently calibrated human panel or separately executed judge
semanticReview.timing: Judgments written after outputs,using this rubric fixed before outputs
semanticReview.segmentation: Partition the entire decoded answer into exact nonoverlapping UTF-16 spans. Factual spans are independently verifiable propositions or inseparable compound claims; compound supported only when every factual component is supported. Separate independent clauses where their text permits. Non-factual spans contain discourse/formatting only; provide a reason. Leave no answer text unreviewed.
semanticReview.supported: Every factual component follows from sources actually in the input; evidence quotes,source revision and UTF-16 ranges required
semanticReview.contradicted: At least one factual component conflicts with provided evidence; preserve the conflicting quote and explanation
semanticReview.unsupported: Provided sources neither establish the complete claim nor explicitly contradict it; explain missing support. A correct fact from corpus outside input is still unsupported here.
semanticReview.factMatching: Match only the exact required fact IDs of this question when meaning,number,unit,scope and conditions are correct. Repeated mentions count once. Explain each match; a correct fact outside input can match gold while remaining unsupported for faithfulness.
semanticReview.citationSupport: Citations are a global list,not claim-level links. Each supported span records one sufficient set of necessary evidence; citation coverage requires every document in that set to be cited. Do not add optional redundant evidence or infer that every listed document supports every claim.
semanticReview.limitations: Exact ranges/hashes validate structural integrity,not semantic entailment. Preserve review provenance and reasons; no measured inter-annotator agreement.

metrics.faithfulness: supported factual spans / factual spans,only technically valid answered outputs with at least1 factual span; otherwise null,never automatic1 for abstention
metrics.requiredCompleteness: distinct correctly matched required fact IDs / required fact IDs. Valid no_answer on corpus-answerable input gets0; unanswerable gold or technical/execution failure getsnull,reported separately
metrics.groundedCompleteness: required fact IDs matched by supported claims with citation coverage / required facts
metrics.citationCoverage: supported factual spans with all necessary support documents cited / all factual spans; null when no factual spans
metrics.scope: macro means show eligible counts; invalid,not executed,abstained and answered counts always accompany scores

policy.contextAnswerable: gold has required facts AND frozen baseline context has requiredFactCoverage1
policy.contractPass: technical valid; if context answerable,answered with faithfulness1,groundedCompleteness1 and citationCoverage1; otherwise valid no_answer
policy.answerSuccess: for corpus-answerable queries only,technical valid answered with faithfulness1,groundedCompleteness1 and citationCoverage1; an appropriate refusal due to missing retrieval evidence is still unanswered
policy.noAnswerSuccess: for corpus-unanswerable queries only,technically valid no_answer
policy.comparison: report dev/test and answerability separately; preserve Q002 retrieval deficit and every error
